text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, after finishing training as usual
with Cheval Grand—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Good work today, Trainer.
Same time tomorrow, then............

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
—Phew, she's as tough as expected. It really
makes me feel like I need to run even more.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I've decided to push myself to the limit today!
If you'd like, wanna do some extra training together?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...I still have some energy left...
I think... maybe I'd like to run just a little bit more."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
O-Of course,
I will follow your judgment, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume train according to their own unique bodies.
Even while knowing there's no need to rush...
choice_data_list: Alright, let's not let them beat us!
Let's channel that motivation into tomorrow's practice!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ah... U-Um... Rather than rivalry...
it's more like I just don't want to fall behind...
choice_data_list: Or if anything, maybe we could ask for a tandem run!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
…………
W-Well then, since we're already here...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Cheval Grand worked hard
on extra training together with Kitasan Black
and Satono Crown.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...You're right.
I know that, but...
Whenever I look around, I just can't help letting it bother me.
choice_data_list: Because you have your own training routine.
You have your own training regimen to focus on

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...You're right.
I was getting ahead of myself."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Becoming a "great Umamusume" takes daily effort...
I look forward to working with you again tomorrow...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cheval Grand headed straight back to the dorms
to rest up and regain her energy for tomorrow.
